## HTTP routes

Routes are shown relative to the Functions host `routePrefix` (default `/api`). `{name}` is the registered graph name. Only Native HTTP routes are a supported contract; Platform routes are explicitly partial.

### Native HTTP (LangGraphApp) — Stable-intent Core

| Method | Route | Documented |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/graphs/{name}/invoke` | yes |
| POST | `/graphs/{name}/stream` | yes |
| GET | `/graphs/{name}/threads/{thread_id}/state` | yes |
| GET | `/health` | yes |
| GET | `/health/details` | yes |
| GET | `/health/ready` | yes |

### Native HTTP (StreamingLangGraphApp) — Experimental

| Method | Route | Documented |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/graphs/{name}/invoke` | yes |
| POST | `/graphs/{name}/stream` | yes |
| GET | `/health` | yes |
| GET | `/health/details` | yes |

### Platform SDK compatibility (partial) — Experimental

| Method | Route | Documented |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/assistants/count` | yes |
| POST | `/assistants/search` | yes |
| GET | `/assistants/{assistant_id}` | no |
| POST | `/runs/stream` | yes |
| POST | `/runs/wait` | yes |
| POST | `/threads` | yes |
| POST | `/threads/count` | yes |
| POST | `/threads/search` | yes |
| DELETE | `/threads/{thread_id}` | yes |
| GET | `/threads/{thread_id}` | yes |
| PATCH | `/threads/{thread_id}` | yes |
| POST | `/threads/{thread_id}/history` | no |
| POST | `/threads/{thread_id}/runs/stream` | yes |
| POST | `/threads/{thread_id}/runs/wait` | yes |
| GET | `/threads/{thread_id}/state` | yes |
| POST | `/threads/{thread_id}/state` | yes |

### Durable async-run lifecycle — Experimental

| Method | Route | Documented |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/graphs/{name}/runs` | yes |
| GET | `/runs/{run_id}` | yes |
| POST | `/runs/{run_id}/cancel` | yes |
